Preconditions: Fee administrator is signed in; an active academic year and Class 10 exist.
Manual steps: 1. Create a fee plan for Class 10. 2. Add tuition fee of 10000 INR and annual fee of 2000 INR. 3. Set the due date. 4. Save.
Expected result: Plan saves once and shows the correct class, fee heads, amounts, due date, and active academic year.

Preconditions: An active Class 10 fee plan exists; Student A is active in Class 10 with no concession.
Manual steps: 1. Run fee generation for the configured period. 2. Open Student A's fee statement.
Expected result: Exactly one invoice is created with tuition 10000 INR, annual fee 2000 INR, correct due date, and total 12000 INR.

Test case: Run invoice generation twice for the same period
Preconditions: FEE-P0-002 has passed.
Manual steps: 1. Run the same generation job again. 2. Search Student A's statement and invoices.
Expected result: No second invoice or duplicate charge is created; the job clearly reports skipped or already-generated records.
Test data: Same student and fee period as FEE-P0-002

Preconditions: Student B is active in Class 10 and has a 25 percent scholarship approval.
Manual steps: 1. Generate Student B's invoice. 2. Inspect invoice line items and balance.
Expected result: Eligible tuition receives a 2500 INR concession; non-eligible annual fee remains unchanged; total due is correct and the concession reason is visible.
Notes: Confirm which fee heads are scholarship-eligible

Test case: Charge transport only to opted-in student
Preconditions: Student C uses transport; Student D in the same class does not.
Manual steps: 1. Generate invoices for both students. 2. Compare line items.
Expected result: Only Student C receives the transport charge. Student D has no transport fee.
Test data: Student C transport 1500 INR; Student D no transport

Test case: Apply late fee after due date
Preconditions: An unpaid invoice exists with a late-fee rule of 100 INR per day, capped at 500 INR.
Manual steps: 1. Set or use a date one day after due date. 2. View or attempt payment. 3. Repeat after enough days to reach cap.
Expected result: Late fee is not charged before/on due date, is calculated correctly after due date, and never exceeds 500 INR.
Test data: Invoice due 10 Oct; rule 100 INR/day; cap 500 INR

Preconditions: An invoice has a late fee; an authorized fee admin is signed in.
Manual steps: 1. Apply a full late-fee waiver with a reason. 2. Reopen the invoice and audit history.
Expected result: Only the late fee is removed; principal remains payable; waiver reason, approver, timestamp, and before/after amount are recorded.
Test data: Late fee 300 INR; reason Medical emergency

Preconditions: An unpaid invoice and a parent payment link are available; use gateway test success flow.
Manual steps: 1. Pay the exact invoice amount. 2. Return to the parent and admin views. 3. Refresh both.
Expected result: One successful payment is recorded; invoice is paid; outstanding is zero; receipt is generated; parent and admin show matching values.
Test data: Invoice total 12000 INR; gateway success test card/UPI

Preconditions: A successful online payment from FEE-P0-008 exists.
Manual steps: 1. Replay the same gateway webhook or use the provider's duplicate-event test. 2. Refresh invoice, payment list, and receipt list.
Expected result: Only one payment, ledger entry, receipt, and notification exist; duplicate callback is safely ignored/logged.

Preconditions: An unpaid invoice and gateway test failure flow are available.
Manual steps: 1. Start payment. 2. Use failed/cancelled provider flow. 3. Inspect parent/admin views.
Expected result: Invoice remains unpaid and payable; failed attempt is recorded; no receipt, paid notification, or duplicate charge is created.

Preconditions: An invoice for 12000 INR is unpaid and partial payments are enabled.
Manual steps: 1. Pay 5000 INR. 2. Open fee statement. 3. Download/view receipt.
Expected result: Payment is recorded as 5000 INR; remaining balance is 7000 INR; invoice is partially paid; receipt is only for amount received.

Preconditions: An authorized fee admin and an unpaid invoice are available.
Manual steps: 1. Record a cash payment for the invoice. 2. Enter receipt/reference number. 3. Review audit history.
Expected result: Payment updates balance exactly once, creates a receipt, and records payment mode, reference, actor, and timestamp.

Preconditions: A completed online or offline payment exists; authorized refund role is signed in.
Manual steps: 1. Refund 2000 INR. 2. Inspect payment history, statement, parent view, and reporting balance.
Expected result: Refund is linked to original payment, has a reason and actor, adjusts outstanding correctly, and produces a credit/refund record without altering unrelated invoices.

Test case: Send only one pre-due reminder to eligible parent
Preconditions: An unpaid invoice is due soon; another student has a paid invoice; reminder template and delivery channel are configured.
Manual steps: 1. Run pre-due reminder job. 2. Inspect delivery records. 3. Run it again for the same reminder window.
Expected result: Only the unpaid student's configured contact receives one reminder; paid student receives none; rerun does not duplicate the message.
Test data: One unpaid and one paid invoice

Test case: Verify receipt matches payment and invoice
Preconditions: A full or partial payment receipt exists.
Manual steps: 1. Open/download receipt. 2. Compare it with invoice and payment record.
Expected result: Receipt number is unique and shows correct student, amount paid, payment method, date, invoice reference, and remaining balance where applicable.
Test data: Use receipt from FEE-P0-008 or FEE-P0-011

Test case: Prevent one parent from viewing another student's fees
Preconditions: Parent A and Parent B accounts exist for different students.
Manual steps: 1. Sign in as Parent A. 2. Attempt direct navigation or API request to Parent B's invoice/receipt. 3. Repeat with browser back/refresh if relevant.
Expected result: Access is denied; Parent A sees only linked student data; no invoice, receipt, or personal data for Parent B is exposed.

Test case: Block unauthorized staff from fee adjustment
Preconditions: A staff account without finance permission and an invoice with balance exist.
Manual steps: 1. Sign in as unauthorized staff. 2. Attempt waiver, refund, offline payment, and fee-plan edit actions.
Expected result: Every restricted action is blocked server-side and in UI; no records change; attempt is handled safely.

Test case: Reconcile gateway settlement with internal payments
Preconditions: At least one success, one failure, and one refund/partial payment are present in test data.
Manual steps: 1. Open reconciliation report. 2. Compare each gateway transaction and total with internal records.
Expected result: Successful payments match gateway references and amounts; failures do not count as collections; refunds are represented correctly; mismatches are visible for action.

Preconditions: Use a controlled cohort with paid, partial, unpaid, concession, late fee, and refund cases.
Manual steps: 1. Open class-wise collection report and defaulter list. 2. Manually total controlled cohort.
Expected result: Collected amount, outstanding, concessions, late fees, refunds, and defaulter membership match individual student ledgers.

Test case: Retry a failed invoice/reminder job safely
Preconditions: Cause a non-destructive job failure in a test environment, such as a temporary notification failure.
Manual steps: 1. Trigger the job and confirm failure. 2. Resolve the condition. 3. Retry the job. 4. Inspect records and messages.
Expected result: Retry completes eligible work without duplicate invoices, adjustments, payments, receipts, or notifications; failure and retry are traceable.
Evidence to capture: Job run history and resulting records

Test case: Keep one school's fee data isolated from another school
Preconditions: Two test schools with separate admins and fee plans exist.
Manual steps: 1. Sign in to School A. 2. Search/report/use direct URLs for School B records. 3. Repeat with School B.
Expected result: No cross-school fee plan, student, invoice, payment, receipt, report, or configuration is visible or modifiable.
Test data: School A and School B test tenants

Preconditions: A controlled student has invoice generation, payment, waiver, refund, and/or adjustment history.
Manual steps: 1. Open student fee ledger/audit history. 2. Compare each event to source documents.
Expected result: Every balance change has event type, amount, actor/system identity, timestamp, source reference, and resulting balance; ledger total matches current outstanding.
